question: On the real-over-HBM Qwen BF16 model, does reducing fixed prefill32 to16 change the tradeoff among existing generation gaps, arriving-request delay and full-cost transfer amortization?
prerequisite: Root must obtain and independently analyze successful Qwen48-layer numerical/loading/request qualification before uploading or running this performance campaign. No performance numbers from the qualification reference run.

workload.scope: Four existing public sources outside Qwen qualification0..3, retokenized using same frozen Qwen tokenizer; not a globally untouched dataset or quality holdout. Prefixes, output limits and absolute arrivals frozen before Qwen performance outcomes; no clock selected from reference-run timing.

ordering: Single engine32/16/16/32 ABBA; two observations per arm with run-order dependence. Descriptive exploratory comparisons, not independently randomized repetitions.

warmup.scope: Both static shapes warm every cell; same prompts reused for warmup and measurement. Pager slots/maps/LRU reset and engine/KV drained after warmup; KV free-block queue not rewritten, allocations remain common.

accounting: TTFT equals declared-arrival-to-submission lag plus native queue until first schedule plus first-schedule-to-first-token. Entire cohort wall includes queueing and synchronous-submit lag; do not add them again. Independent policy state/routes/free outputs; payload measured from actual copy requests, not wire bytes. Group count alone is not total cost. Host/GPU spans may overlap.
metrics: whole finite-cohort wall and output throughput
engine calls, scheduled positions, expert groups, actual tensor-copy payload
whole lifecycle and memory; separate setup/warmup/capture/flush/shutdown
required_checks: 16 measured requests/416 outputs and4x388 positions; warmup32 requests/64 outputs separately
all ready decode scheduled once, no preemption
each16/32 threshold applied before native.schedule and actual prefill sizes recorded
pure decode unique<=32 and1expert group perlayer; this does not imply0misses
each policy own future KV/routes/output and all attempts retained
same-arm repeats and adverse metrics retained, no empirical maximum declared noise bound
strongest_baseline: The stronger measured ordinary static among16 and32 for each metric within this same resource configuration. Two points are not a globally optimized static or exact Oracle.
claim_ceiling: Measured full-request tradeoffs on one finite clock episode, one true-over-HBM model and this backend. No new scheduler, production p99, statistical significance/noninferiority, sustained capacity, task quality/equivalence or expert-history decision-value claim.
stop: GPU query/foreign process, source/input/resource mismatch, missing request/position, ready-decode omission, preemption, nonfinite or failed integrity stops with evidence retained. Do not tune seed, arrival times or thresholds on this episode.
closure: Positive, negative or tradeoff result closes this bounded true-over-HBM comparison and supports a measurement synthesis with the prior OLMoE/artificial-budget results. Retain unproven online selector/history increment and quality/capacity limits; do not automatically launch another mechanism.
loading: Single official BaseModelLoader lifecycle. Sixteen ordered frozen hash-checked shards streamed one at a time; clone each CPU tensor to break mmap ownership, native Qwen load_weights copies into target. Remove only owned successful consumed shard copies; preserve failed partial file and receipt. Strict source coverage and target return-name coverage; native postprocessing and eval retained.

memory_budget.boundary: Sizing excludes CUDA context/attention/workspace/allocator and pinned-copy transients; actual whole lifecycle sampled. Host current includes reclaimable file pages. No claim theoretical subtotal guarantees fit.
